body: Booking confirmations stopped going out last week. Checked the logs — booking-api is CrashLoopBackOff with 7 restarts. Error: Mailgun API authentication failed (401). The key was rotated and MAILGUN_API_KEY in .env was never updated, so mg.crossroadsconservatory.com sends fail.
Thanks Marcus. This is a blocker — families can't finish a booking and we never see the deposit. Inquiry volume jumps right before fall enrollment, so I need the form working. Please prioritize.
Fix is straightforward: update the Kubernetes secret with the new Mailgun key, redeploy booking-api. I'll also document the rotation step so this doesn't break again after the next key change.
Reproduced on Safari 17.4. The calendar embed on /book never renders the time slots — the iframe loads blank. Chrome and Firefox are fine. Students on iPhones literally can't pick a lesson time.
Plan: pull the available slots from the booking-api directly and render them in a responsive list, keeping the iframe only as a desktop fallback. Should fix mobile without changing the booking flow.
Stripe deposit flow is live. Booking a lesson now collects a $40 deposit through Stripe Checkout, and the confirmation is sent by booking-api. Receipts route through the Stripe dashboard too.
Tested a booking end to end and the deposit landed in the account. Works great. Closing this one.
Bios for Ray and Claire are written and approved. Headshots uploaded to /assets/instructors/. Will get the rest of the part-time instructors in this week.
Store embed looks fine on desktop but overflows on mobile. May need a custom product grid instead of the default widget. Will put together both options before we build.
Moving this to a later cycle. Can't scope the student portal until the booking and payment flow is stable and we know how the student login will work.
Reviewed the summer camp roster — 18 confirmed, 2 waitlist.
Second album pre-production: 6 tunes committed, 4 still under discussion.
Confirmed the lesson slot with the parent — Tuesday 4pm.
Ray suggested tightening the bridge on the fifth chart before the Spotlight Room date.
Claire flagged that we need a substitute for Thursday's ensemble.
Sofia asked about the winter choir concert — logistics locked in.
Frank sent notes on the Coltrane transcription — apply on Sunday.
Tomoko rescheduled the Tuesday rehearsal to 7:15.
